dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #Um... Hm? Oh, hey there, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Want to play a clapping game?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I—I'm good... No need to worry about me.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I'm really happy that you invited me to hang out here...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Uh, um... Ugh, you saw right through me...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: *exhale* Give me a moment. ...I am in a sea of Zaytun Peaches.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Gently push the peaches away... There. And that's how you chase the jitterbugs away.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Ah, but back to your question... I really like the way you've decorated this place. It's so snug and cozy.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But I've never left Sumeru City before, so suddenly being taken to a new place is...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I don't know what I'm supposed to be doing, or who to talk to...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Can I stay here a little longer, so I can get used to everything?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Hehe, I won't be nervous anymore once I'm more familiar with this place.

choices.text: Do you want to pet Tubby?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Huh? Wait, so that round bird is named Tubby?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: *Giggle* That name is quite on the nose. It sure is descriptive.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Just looking at her makes me feel relaxed, like right after you do a huuuge cat stretch.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Sure, I'd be happy to. What do you want to chat about?

choices.text: I'd like to hear your latest thoughts...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Huh? Mine?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I've been wondering which came first: the audience or the performance?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I'd probably have to sift through a whole bunch of documents and stuff if I really wanted to get that answer, but I'm no good at things like that.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Hee-hee, so it's just a random thought...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Oh no, we were supposed to chat together, but I've been doing all the talking...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Alright, the ball's back to you — catch! I want to hear about your experiences and the people you've met.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Tell me all about them! I'm all ears!

choices.text: About everyone at the Grand Bazaar...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Oh, I just love the atmosphere. It feels like one big, happy family.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Everyone has different personalities, so there are some small squabbles here and there...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: But if anyone runs into a problem, everyone else will help out however they can.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Isn't that what family's like?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: They bicker and fight, but they'll always be your biggest supporters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hmm... Want to make some flower pots?

choices.text: You know how to do that?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Well, I didn't, but I wanted to do something memorable with you, so... I got my friends at the Grand Bazaar to help me learn in secret.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Oh, don't worry, I made sure I knew how to make them before asking you.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Because I want to, um...

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I'd like to transplant some Padisarahs.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I grew them myself, and I've already picked out some good ones.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: They're my favorite flower, so I wanted to give them to you, my favorite person.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: May happy times always be with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you, Nilou.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: No need to thank me. As long as you like them.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Whenever you're free, let me know and I'll do a performance for you.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Relax, I'm confident now. I don't even need to do the deep breathing exercises... After all, we've already known each other for a long time now.

choices.text: Any flower you want to plant in particular?

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: Yes — I've put a lot of thought into it.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: I want to do something special for you in return for all the help you've given me.

response.speaker: Nilou
response.text: You don't seem like you're too worried about anything, so my movement therapy won't be of much use. Instead, I was thinking...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Would you like to be the first person in my audience today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Is it alright if I poke your forehead? Just gently, I mean. I heard it helps people have good dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Wooow, how dazzling!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, I actually noticed a long time ago that you have good taste in art.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: The same beauty is found in all forms of art. Whether it's a dance or a gemstone, you use the same pair of eyes to admire it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Did you... build this theater yourself? Wow, it's the spitting image... Amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: But we can't let a fantastic stage like this be without a dancer, can we?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, I can't wait to try out my new dance on it. The dance still needs a name, though... Could you pick one for me?
